# Editor fonts

These fonts are bundled unchanged and served locally. They affect the editor display only, not generated PDFs. Public distribution notices are also included in public/fonts/LICENSES.txt.

- **Source Code Pro Regular**, Adobe (SIL Open Font License 1.1). Source: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-code-pro at 803b7e23ec97ae58b6232ea76519a76d428ba268, WOFF2/OTF/SourceCodePro-Regular.otf.woff2. See SourceCodePro-LICENSE.md.
- **OpenDyslexic Mono Regular**, Abelardo Gonzalez, with original fonts by Bitstream. Source: https://github.com/antijingoist/open-dyslexic at 2a0133f365a9f1084f15ced78eafa4f54113afa8, otf/OpenDyslexicMono-Regular.otf. This archived font's embedded notice specifies Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported for OpenDyslexic changes and the Bitstream license for original glyphs; those embedded notices remain intact. The newer font family's SIL-OFL announcement is not used to relabel this older binary. See CC-BY-3.0.txt and Bitstream-Vera.txt.

OpenDyslexic embedded attribution: Original Fonts are © Bitstream. OpenDyslexic changes and additional glyphs by Abelardo Gonzalez are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License.
